calls.statement:
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory AS product_group, SUM(f.quantity) - COALESCE(MAX(r.ret_units), 0) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN (SELECT 107 AS sid, SUM(rl.quantity_returned) AS ret_units FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key = rl.store_key JOIN dim_product rp ON rp.product_key = rl.product_key WHERE rs.store_id = 107 AND rp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') r ON r.sid = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory
